title: Grateful Dead Live at Greek Theatre, University Of California on 1981-09-13
lineage: 1st generation cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp (24/96) > Adobe Audition CC 2019 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Mixed review noting a solid show with a standout Brokedown Palace, but a sound mix that keeps Garcia too low
ai_review.review: The concert is praised as a "mighty fine run" and highlighted by a closing Brokedown Palace, yet the recording suffers from an unbalanced mix that pushes Garcia’s guitar down. While the performance itself feels enjoyable for a Sunday afternoon set, the technical shortcomings keep it from being fully satisfying.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; positive remarks about the show offset by a notable mix problem, leading to an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Garcia's guitar is reported as too low in the mix, indicating balance issues; no other clarity or noise comments provided.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a relaxed Sunday afternoon run with a satisfying closing number.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar is noted as too low in the mix.
